Manual rollback takes time; automatic rollback can act in seconds.

   They’re not perfect, but they’re a low-cost way to detect degradation. If model confidence drops significantly (e.g., avg. confidence falls below a threshold, or outliers spike), it’s a strong signal something’s wrong — even if the model isn’t “broken” in a traditional sense.
